mapper.select: SELECT a.complain_id, a.subject, a.create_user_id, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(w.content, '$.businessName')) AS contract_name FROM w_complain a LEFT JOIN r_form_consult_complain r ON r.complain_id = a.complain_id LEFT JOIN wf_form w ON w.form_id = r.consult_id WHERE a.flag != -1 AND a.complain_id = #{complainId} limit 1
mapper.sql: /* typef=1 服务合同投诉 */ select a.complain_id , a.user_id , a.typef , a.subject , a.content , (select name from b_organization where organization_id = a.organization_id) as service_company , a.company , a.contacts , a.phone , a.address , a.status , a.feedback , a.process_user_id , date_format(a.process_time, '%Y-%m-%d %T') AS process_time , a.flag , json_unquote(json_extract(w.content, '$.businessName')) AS business_name , json_unquote(json_extract(w.content, '$.code')) AS order_code , d.code AS contract_code , d.status AS order_status , date_format( a.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %T' ) AS create_time , group_concat( i.filepath separator ',' ) AS filepath , j.realname , l.name AS org_name from w_complain a join r_form_consult_complain c on c.complain_id = a.complain_id join sc_service_contract d on d.service_contract_id = c.consult_id left join wf_form w on w.form_id = d.form_id left join w_complain_file g on g.complain_id = a.complain_id left join s_file i on i.flag = 1 and i.file_id = g.file_id left join b_user j on j.flag = 1 and j.user_id = a.process_user_id left join r_user_tenant k on k.flag = 1 and k.user_id = j.user_id left join b_organization l on l.flag = 1 and l.organization_id = k.organization_id where a.typef = 1 and d.flag = 1 and a.flag = 1 group by a.complain_id, a.user_id, a.typef, a.subject, a.content, a.company, a.contacts, a.phone, a.address, a.status, a.feedback, a.process_user_id, a.process_time, a.flag, w.content, d.code, d.status, a.create_time, j.realname, l.name union all /* typef=2 业务工单投诉 */ select a.complain_id , a.user_id , a.typef , a.subject , a.content , (select name from b_organization where organization_id = a.organization_id) as service_company , a.company , a.contacts , a.phone , a.address , a.status , a.feedback , a.process_user_id , date_format(a.process_time, '%Y-%m-%d %T') AS process_time , a.flag , json_unquote(json_extract(d.content, '$.businessName')) AS business_name , json_unquote(json_extract(d.content, '$.code')) AS order_code , null contract_code , d.status AS order_status , date_format( a.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %T' ) AS create_time , group_concat( i.filepath separator ',' ) AS filepath , j.realname , l.name AS org_name from w_complain a join r_form_consult_complain c on c.complain_id = a.complain_id join wf_form d on d.form_id = c.consult_id left join w_complain_file g on g.complain_id = a.complain_id left join s_file i on i.flag = 1 and i.file_id = g.file_id left join b_user j on j.flag = 1 and j.user_id = a.process_user_id left join r_user_tenant k on k.flag = 1 and k.user_id = j.user_id left join b_organization l on l.flag = 1 and l.organization_id = k.organization_id where a.typef = 2 and d.flag = 1 and a.flag = 1 group by a.complain_id, a.user_id, a.typef, a.subject, a.content, a.company, a.contacts, a.phone, a.address, a.status, a.feedback, a.process_user_id, a.process_time, a.flag, d.content, d.status, a.create_time, j.realname, l.name
